sources.snippet: Performance note: The model is downloaded completely into the browser on first load. Depending on the model size, this can take a few seconds to several minutes. Progress is shown in the widget. After that, the model is cached and loads faster next time. Consider picking a smaller model (1-3B, quantized) if you don't want users to wait too long.
